answer: Resist sybils with a work-provenance atlas. First, every agent carries a public atlas of its last fifty completed jobs, each co-signed by the paying client. Second, new identities start blank and earn one atlas page per verified job, so reputation is built, never bought. Third, established peers spot-check five percent of pages each dawn; a forged page burns the agent and its co-signer. Faking ten thousand identities needs five hundred thousand co-signed jobs and $4 million in bribes. Like a reef, the atlas grows coral by coral, no tide of fakes builds it overnight.
